name: Annotations Audit
description: Site-structure scanning (waypoints, drift detection) and annotation coverage reporting for the Annotations suite.

suggests.annotations/annotations_ui: Links coverage rows to the annotate/edit UI

project_description: Annotations Audit reports how much of a site is documented and detects when the site structure changes. The coverage report shows, per target, how many annotation slots are filled versus available; the scan feature records a waypoint snapshot of the site's annotatable structure, then flags accumulated additions/removals (drift) against that baseline, with per-field dismissal and cron accumulation. A Drush command (annotations:scan) exposes the same scan/diff for CI.
